_comment: Keyword -> action config. Edit and restart the service; no deploy needed.
Rules are ordered and the FIRST match wins, so put specific keywords above generic ones.
NEVER put a rule's own keyword inside its publicReply. We post that reply, Meta hands it
back to us as a NEW comment with a NEW id, it matches again, and the account answers
itself until Instagram throttles it. The dedupe table cannot catch it — every loop step
has an id it has never seen. The service refuses to start quietly on this: check the log.
Meta allows exactly ONE private reply per comment, ever — dm.text and dm.link are
concatenated into that single message, so it has to carry the whole payload.
